predCalcTimes(self, predicateRules)

 

Return a list of tuples of name and calculation time (in secs) of geo predicates in predicateRules.

Parameters:
  • predicateRules ([(PiSPEC, Geo)])
Returns: [(str, float | None)]
A list of tuples of name and calculation time (in seconds) of GeoPredicate:s given in predicateRules (time is None if a predicate has not been calculated yet). The list is in descending order w.r.t. calculation time.
